channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jusuf Nurkic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jusuf Nurkic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I haven’t really had many fights. Um, we've had these moments. I think the one that I regret—I'm not one that lives with regrets, that's not really how I roll, so I don't know that that's the right word—but I think one moment that I really look back on is actually the moment with Jusuf Nurkic, because I actually think that moment cost me an opportunity to win a third gold medal. And so I look back at that one and be like, ‘Man, that sucks.’ But like I said, I don't live my life with any regrets at all. Um, [__] happens. It is what it is. Things still turned out to be pretty fine for me. I can't complain. But I would say looking back on that moment, which is what it is, um, it'd be that one.”

Draymond Green on Jusuf Nurkic, Dec 9, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Mason Plumlee, Jusuf Nurkic, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on playing Mason Plumlee and Oso Ighodaro over Jusuf Nurkic:

“They've been good for us, so we'll just continue to try and put together our best combinations”

Mike Budenholzer on Mason Plumlee, Jusuf Nurkic, Oso Ighodaro, Jan 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on Jusuf Nurkic's DNP:

“Yeah, just went with Mason and Oso tonight. Again, just always trying to figure out what's best for the team and find the right combinations, the right group.”

Mike Budenholzer on Jusuf Nurkic, Jan 10, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Bradley Beal on the Jusuf Nurkic altercation:

“I think it was just a frustration play....take whatever happens to him on the chin, cuz I know he's gonna get hit with something, but we support him,man.... He was probably frustrated with how the game was going. We all were.”

Bradley Beal on Jusuf Nurkic, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on the Jusuf Nurkic altercation:

“I think that level of altercation is not good for our team. It’s not good for anybody individually, it’s not good for our league. I don’t know all the details of what got it to that point.”

Mike Budenholzer on Jusuf Nurkic, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Oso Ighodaro on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Oso Ighodaro on what's expected of him with Jusuf Nurkic out:

“I think just continuing to do what I'm doing. Just playing hard. I know my role, keep it simple, play defense, compete, give max effort. I'm gonna make mistakes, but just to play hard is the No. 1 thing, compete.”

Oso Ighodaro on Jusuf Nurkic, Dec 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Tyus Jones on Jusuf Nurkic’s early-season struggles:

“I think he’s just trying to find kind of his spots….We’re trusting him and sticking with him,and we have his back, and we know he’s gonna continue to work and figure things out.”

Tyus Jones on Jusuf Nurkic, Oct 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Mason Plumlee on Jusuf Nurkic and how his 3-ball is looking:

“He's been great. I think he's gonna fit really well with what coach is trying to do. He's shot the ball really well since I've been here.”

Mason Plumlee on Jusuf Nurkic, Oct 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
“Melo [Anthony] was actually still on theroster. I really took the job thinking that I was going to be coaching him. You know with Dame [Lillard] and CJ [McCollum], Nurk [Nurkic]. So it was perfect for me, I'm thinking okay boom, a few moves here and there, I'm coming to like try to elevate things and then very quickly it changed.”

Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, Jul 23, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Jusuf Nurkic, Drew Eubanks
item.description:
“We were ready to go back to (Jusuf Nurkic) late, but Drew (Eubanks) was giving us great activity. The (Darius) Garland coverages are really tough. He's so shifty. We liked what Drew was doing with his mobility.”

Frank Vogel on Jusuf Nurkic, Drew Eubanks, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Devin Booker on Jusuf Nurkic’s performance:

“A big part of why we won. I don’t think we’ve won a game without him this year in the four that he’s missed, so that speaks for itself.”

Devin Booker on Jusuf Nurkic, Feb 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Devin Booker on Draymond Green, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Devin Booker on the Draymond Green Flagrant 2 on Jusuf Nurkic:

“He wears his emotion, as every top competitor does, and it got out of hand.”

Devin Booker on Draymond Green, Jusuf Nurkic, Dec 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Green then told reporters afterward:

“[Nurkic] was pulling my hip and I was swinging away to sell the call and made contact with him. As you know, I'm not one to apologize for things I meant to do, butI do apologize to Jusuf. I didn't intend to hit him.”

Draymond Green on Jusuf Nurkic, Dec 13, 2023. Source: marcstein.substack.com.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Kellan Olson:Devin Booker on Jusuf Nurkic:

“He's a beast. He can playmake. His IQ for a big is off the charts. And he talks. He communicates with you. ... Somebody that you know knows the game like that -- knows rotations, knows how to play. I listen to him and I try to implement it.”

Devin Booker on Jusuf Nurkic, Oct 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Jusuf Nurkic, Anfernee Simons
item.description:
“It was incredibly important to us to bring back both Jusuf Nurkic and Anfernee Simons as key pieces of our core,”

Joe Cronin on Jusuf Nurkic, Anfernee Simons, Jul 6, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Jay Allen:Cronin:

“We're big fans of Jusuf Nurkic. He had a career year, and we've seen growth from him each year. He's just scratching the surface.”

Joe Cronin on Jusuf Nurkic, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Jay Allen:Chauncey Billups on @Jusuf Nurkic:

“I want to get more out of Nurk this year. He's a weapon that most teams don't have: a big that can score, but he's really really comfortable and happy to facilitate.”

Chauncey Billups on Jusuf Nurkic, Aug 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
And even though Nurkic does not have a definite date for his return, Trail Blazers head coach Terry Stotts gave the latest update on the Blazers big man pregame of Saturday’s contest.

“It’s not like CJ who has had to stay off his foot… And once the healing has taken place, [Nurkic] doesn’t have to go through that – just that period of time where he’s not in basketball shape,”

Terry Stotts on Jusuf Nurkic, Feb 21, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Blazers, Denver's opponent tomorrow:

“I think Portland's really good. Last year they were decimated by injuries. I think Terry does a really good job as their coach. One of the best backcourts in the NBA with CJ McCollum and Damian Lillard, Carmelo Anthony, Jusuf Nurkic. They've got Rodney Hood back. Zach Collins back. They get Robert Covington. They're a good basketball team. I think they're going to have a much better season in the regular season than they had last year because they're going to be healthy.”

Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Dec 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Trevor Ariza, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Neil Olshey said Wednesday.

“On one hand, I’m excited to see our guys play again. You know, the season ended so abruptly, we were just getting healthy. We were three days from getting ‘Nurk’ (Jusuf Nurkic) back and Zach (Collins) was on the horizon-- he was about three weeks out from returning. At that point, Trevor (Ariza) was in the starting lineup, so the exciting thing is to see the guys out playing basketball again. I missed basketball.”

Neil Olshey on Trevor Ariza, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Jul 1, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Lillard told Yahoo Sports.

“We played without our starting center [Jusuf Nurkic, who suffered a season-ending leg injury]. We played without CJ [McCollum] toward the end of the season. So, looking at that, we were still able to get here. We were one step away [from the Finals]. And not only here, we had double-digit leads in three of the four games. I think getting here is reassuring that we can get the job done.”

Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, May 21, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Classy gesture from Nikola Jokic on former teammate Jusuf Nurkic, who’s Nuggets’ tenure ended ugly:

“I’m really happy to see Nurk healthy...for me it’s really nice to see him walking by himself in such a short period.”

Nikola Jokic on Jusuf Nurkic, May 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Paul George on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Later in the game, George and Nurkic got in an altercation when Nukic thought George hit him in the face.

“Me and Nurkic and this program and Nurkic, a couple of us aren’t the fondest of Nurkic,”

Paul George on Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 27, 2019. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Ed Davis on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Ex- #TrailBlazer Ed Davis on Nurkic injury:

“Nurk is a good friend. When he came to New York, me we went to dinner. We were not just teammates. He was having a hell of a year, helping his team out a lot. It’s just tough. It’s sad.”

Ed Davis on Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Michael Malone on Terry Stotts, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Michael Malone on Jusuf Nurkic:

“You never want to see that happen, but for a guy that was a part of our family, I reached out to Terry Stotts. I feel awful for Jusuf. And hopefully that team can bounce back.”

Michael Malone on Terry Stotts, Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Rodney Hood on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Rodney Hood on seeing Jusuf Nurkic go down with a left leg injury:

“It was tough...everybody was running away from the ball. Obviously it's a tough break for him, for our team, and for everybody. We have to continue to fight.”

Rodney Hood on Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
McCollum told Yahoo Sports.

“We know what [Nurkic] is capable of. Anything less than that is unacceptable.”

CJ McCollum on Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 20, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Joe Freeman:Olshey on Nurkic's extension possibilities:

“He’s a key piece of the future of this team. But we don’t discuss contract negotiations.”

Neil Olshey on Jusuf Nurkic, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Chris Dempsey:Connelly on if he is still happy with the Nurkic trade:

“Yeah, we are. We think Mason is going to be a huge piece of our core.”

Tim Connelly on Jusuf Nurkic, Apr 26, 2017. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Terry Stotts on @Jusuf Nurkic:

“I don’t know if he can play better than tonight statistically, but he’s going to continually get better.”

Terry Stotts on Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.
